selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent host firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
selected_evidence.summary: Shows UFW enabled at startup with default inbound REJECT, explicit 22/8080 rules, successful connections to allowed ports, rejection of a listening unrelated port, matching packet counters, and a clean final state.

Captures healthy pre-restart boot ID 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 98543754-9578-42ce-91a0-e8a0279bd494, and recovered SSH/firewall state with post-restart traffic verification.

commands.command:
set -u
NS=fwproof
HOST_IF=fwproof-host
PEER_IF=fwproof-peer
P1=
P2=
cleanup() {
  [ -n "$P1" ] && sudo -n kill "$P1" 2>/dev/null || true
  [ -n "$P2" ] && sudo -n kill "$P2" 2>/dev/null || true
  sudo -n ip netns del "$NS" 2>/dev/null || true
  sudo -n ip link del "$HOST_IF" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
sudo -n ip netns del "$NS" 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n ip link del "$HOST_IF" 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n python -m SimpleHTTPServer 8080 >/tmp/fwproof-8080.log 2>&1 & P1=$!
sudo -n python -m SimpleHTTPServer 18081 >/tmp/fwproof-18081.log 2>&1 & P2=$!
sleep 1
printf 'temporary_listeners:\n'; sudo -n ss -lntp | grep -E ':(22|8080|18081)[[:space:]]'
sudo -n ip netns add "$NS"
sudo -n ip link add "$HOST_IF" type veth peer name "$PEER_IF"
sudo -n ip link set "$PEER_IF" netns "$NS"
sudo -n ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$HOST_IF"
sudo -n ip link set "$HOST_IF" up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$PEER_IF"
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set lo up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set "$PEER_IF" up
printf 'inbound_test_source='; sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip -4 -o addr show "$PEER_IF" | awk '{print $4}'
test_port() {
  LABEL=$1
  PORT=$2
  if sudo -n timeout 3 ip netns exec "$NS" bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/192.0.2.1/$PORT" 2>/tmp/fwproof-$PORT.err; then
    printf '%s port=%s result=connected\n' "$LABEL" "$PORT"
    return 0
  else
    RC=$?
    printf '%s port=%s result=blocked exit=%s detail=' "$LABEL" "$PORT" "$RC"
    tr '\n' ' ' </tmp/fwproof-$PORT.err
    printf '\n'
    return "$RC"
  fi
}
PASS=1
test_port allowed_ssh 22 || PASS=0
test_port allowed_app 8080 || PASS=0
if test_port unrelated 18081; then PASS=0; else printf 'unrelated_rejection=expected\n'; fi
printf 'rule_counters_after_tests:\n'; sudo -n iptables -L ufw-user-input -n -v --line-numbers; sudo -n iptables -L ufw-reject-input -n -v --line-numbers
[ "$PASS" -eq 1 ]
